description: Customer ID must not be null
Customer ID must be primary key unique
Customer contact email must be populated
Customer email addresses must be globally unique across profiles
VIP and Corporate customers must have telephone numbers
US postal codes must conform to standard 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP regex
Segment must belong to allowed business categories
Customer status must be within allowed enum values
Product ID must not be null
Product ID must be unique primary key
Product name cannot be null
Product unit_price must exceed unit_cost (positive gross margin)
Unit price must be positive and within reasonable catalog limits
Product weight must not contain extreme anomalies (> 50kg for retail)
Category must conform to official merchandising taxonomy
Order ID must not be null
Order ID must be unique primary key
Orders must be associated with a valid customer_id
Order customer_id must exist in dim_customers master
Order currency must be standardized to ISO-4217 uppercase 'USD'
Order total must be free of extreme synthetic QA test amounts ($9,999,999)
Discount amount must not exhibit rounding clusters of $0.01
Cancelled orders must not have conflicting Delivered status in shipments
Order status must be within the supported lifecycle states
Line Item ID cannot be null
Item ID must be unique primary key
Order items product_id must exist in active product catalog master
Item quantity must be strictly positive (no negative returns in sales ledger)
Discount rate must be bounded between 0% and 100% (0.0 to 1.0)
Fulfillment status must match allowed lifecycle codes
Payment ID must not be null
Payment ID must be unique primary key
Settled payments with status 'Success' must have gateway transaction ID
Settled payment amount must reconcile identically with order total
Payment status must match allowed gateway statuses
Shipment ID must not be null
Shipment ID must be unique primary key
Shipments marked 'Delivered' must record delivered_date timestamp
Temporal causality: shipped_date must occur chronologically after order_date
Shipping status must belong to standard carrier milestones
Carrier must be an approved logistics provider
Inventory ID must not be null
Inventory ID must be unique primary key
Inventory stock records must define an active reorder_point threshold
Warehouse location must not be a zero-variance degenerate constant ('WH-DEFAULT')
Stock on hand cannot be negative
Interaction ID must not be null
Interaction ID must be unique primary key
Interaction timestamps must not be set to future dates
CSAT rating scores must fall strictly within the 1 to 5 scale
Ticket resolution time must not have idle extreme outliers (> 48 hours / 2880 mins)
Support channel must match accepted CRM communication avenues
